title: باغ‌داران از هزینه‌های «ته‌جایی دروازه‌ها» در کابل شکایت دارند
summary: Farmers, Drivers Complain About Municipal Fees on Agricultural Products Hayatullah.Rahimi Mon, 10/12/2026 - 22:34 Author Liluma Qadiry Business Every day, vehicles carrying fruits and vegetables from different provinces and districts enter Kabul city, where Kabul Municipality collects fees from them under a system known as “Tah-Jayi Darwaza” (entry-point fees). Vehicles transporting agricultural products stop at designated locations, where drivers are required to pay these fees. However, drivers say the charges, in addition to transportation, fuel, and other expenses, have increased their financial burden, making it difficult for them to cover the costs under the current economic conditions.
